token_measurement: Measure exactly with the selected model tokenizer during compilation; repository checks use a conservative 6000 UTF-8 byte ceiling.
authority: ADAPTAR explicit effects requiring human authorization.
scope: Execute only the declared delta and preserve unmentioned behavior, contracts, data and configuration.
completion: Intent satisfied AND applicable Contracts met AND Evidence sufficient and fresh.
evidence: Execution and verification are separate; missing, stale or executor-reported success is not evidence.
economics: Use the smallest sufficient capability, context and architecture; optimize cost per validated outcome.
unknown_rule: Unknown remains unknown and triggers bounded investigation or escalation.
